strategy.primary: Turbo combo: fast mana and tutors race to Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation/Tainted Pact or Underworld Breach lines (LED + Brain Freeze, Wheel of Fortune + Jeska's Will, Grinding Station + Mox Amber).
strategy.secondary: Commander-native mayhem: Norman connives unblockably, then Green Goblin makes every nonland card discarded this turn castable from the graveyard for {2} less, turning loot and discard outlets into card advantage.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Norman Osborn // Green Goblin
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Norman Osborn can't be blocked.
Whenever Norman Osborn deals combat damage to a player, he connives. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)
{1}{U}{B}{R}: Transform Norman Osborn. Activate only as a sorcery.
Flying, menace
Spells you cast from your graveyard cost {2} less to cast.
Goblin Formula — Each nonland card in your graveyard has mayhem. The mayhem cost is equal to its mana cost. (You may cast a card from your graveyard for its mayhem cost if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply.)
commander_oracle_snapshots.type_line: Legendary Creature — Human Scientist Villain // Legendary Creature — Goblin Human Villain
